reason: Declares agent automation modes, stream event envelopes and the protocol version. The Agent API and event service own request admission, subscriptions and event publication.
Declares event payloads and listener signatures. The agent event service owns per-run sequencing, listener registration, and the last heartbeat.
Declares connector account status labels and policy input shapes. The connector account manager reads and changes account status.
Declares the serialized setup response and constructs error envelopes from its inputs. Connector setup handlers own the pairing and configuration transitions.
Declares storage adapter operations, selectors and result shapes. Adapter and runtime implementations own transactions, persistence and request lifetimes.
Declares evaluator inputs, prepared context, evidence and results. Runtime dispatch and each evaluator own invocation and result handling.
Declares hook requirements, event payloads, configuration and a default priority. The hook service owns registration, execution and removal.
Declares memory records, source ranges, revisions and share grants. Runtime memory services and adapters own access, persistence and mutation.
Declares message processing options, turn outcomes and reply recovery receipts. The message service and its callers own turn admission, processing and settlement.
Declares payment configuration and x402 validation results. Payment handlers own authorization, provider calls and settlement.
Declares the runtime and connector interfaces and fixed target labels. AgentRuntime and host adapters own service lifecycle, dispatch and cancellation.
Declares model context and action plan values and failure shapes. Runtime composition and action execution own creation and updates.
Declares streamed tool, action and evaluation payloads and callbacks. Runtime stream handlers own production, cancellation and delivery.
Declares view isolation, capability and shell policy fields. The app view host owns navigation and surface lifetime.
Declares task records, status labels and executor interfaces. TaskService and the scheduler own registration, admission, dispatch and retirement.
Declares versioned trajectory, reward and training export records. Runtime trajectory recorders and export consumers own capture and durable publication.
Declares trigger configuration, wake modes, status labels and run records. Scheduling and workflow services own registration, firing and result publication.
